steps.content: The defenses were more stringent than expected, indicating that this place held significant importance to the enemy. Yet, Rahu succeeded. When she penetrated the target location, it was eerily silent inside.
A figure in black has collapsed on the floor. A woman in purple stands next to him, a long umbrella in her drooping hand. A viscous liquid drips off its tip, giving off the stench of death.
The collapsed man is clad in a black raincoat, seeming to have been impaled by the umbrella defenselessly. A familiar single-eyed rune is branded on his palm.
The woman stares down blankly at the man slumped next to her heels. She only turns slowly to Rahu a while after she's barged in.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: ...Such intense power. You're the FAC Sinner, the one who defeated Garofano.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Too bad, you came too late.
Rahu glances at the figure in black, and readies her sword-shield.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: That's Garofano's patron. Did you do that to shut him up?

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Patron? More like a swindler.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Garofano didn't care about bounties, she only wanted to stop Paradeisos from harming us. These scum targeted her impatience. She was baited by fake intelligence and went ahead to challenge Paradeisos on her own.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: We're merely wilting flowers that got lumped together, yet she treated us as family and even went that far for us. Ha...

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Garofano, we've gotten rid of the vermin that deceived and used you. We'll come and save you, until then, don't try anything stupid...
Bang! With a sharp blow, Rahu subdues the sorrowful assassin. When her shield collides with the umbrella, she realizes it's a hefty metal umbrella. Of course, this woman is a Sinner too.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Stop talking in riddles. Explain what happened.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Attacking Erica Villa, spreading Mania contamination, injuring many... She acted as the Mania merchant's knife. Her crimes cannot be pardoned simply because she was used.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Ha... Listen to your pretty talk, Paradeisos's lapdog.
With the flickering light from the monitor screen, Rahu finally makes out the woman's face. Her eyes are hollow as ashes, her face streaked with stubborn tear stains.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: You have eyes like ours. I bet you've had someone important in your life.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: After struggling in the dark for years, you met the only light in your life. You'd never dreamed that he would appear, but he did.
steps.female_content: After struggling in the dark for years, you met the only light in your life. You'd never dreamed that she would appear, but she did.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...I have no idea what you're talking about.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: But you do, in your head.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Whose image are you seeing in your mind? Who do you get courage and strength from?

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: You thank him, cherish him, would give up everything for him, even your life. Whenever you think of him, you no longer feel lost. Do you have that person in mind?
steps.female_content: You thank her, cherish her, would give up everything for her, even your life. Whenever you think of her, you no longer feel lost. Do you have that person in mind?

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: ...Now think about someone taking him away from you!
steps.female_content: ...Now think about someone taking her away from you!

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Somewhere you don't know, your cherished one is being mercilessly used and ruined. You don't know whether he's dead or alive. Before you're aware, you've lost him forever, without even a chance to fight for him.
steps.female_content: Somewhere you don't know, your cherished one is being mercilessly used and ruined. You don't know whether she's dead or alive. Before you're aware, you've lost her forever, without even a chance to fight for her.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Imagine it. Experience it once more. And you'll understand how I feel.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Paradeisos is the reason why we're exploited and destroyed repeatedly, like we don't matter.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: You have eyes like ours. Then why are you still on their side?!
The woman shouts as she draws a compact weapon with one hand and throws it at Rahu. Rahu dodges narrowly and as she's about to strike back, she notices the enemy's body mutating.
The assassin's body is emitting faint red spikes of light. The luminous spikes are intertwined with filthy contamination. Mania. The sight is so ominous that even Rahu dares not get close.

The woman in purple is suffering in pain, yet she doesn't resist or loathe the luminous spikes. Instead, she lifts her hand to touch them. Soon, the spikes shatter and only sorrow remains on the woman's face.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: ...Fine, I don't have a reason to fight you. Just cut me some slack, don't make me wreck this place. The intelligence here is crucial to you. Take a close look, you won't wanna miss anything.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: When you're back, tell your owner...

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: "The bloom season's here. The Mentor is off to the banquet... just as you wish."

She disappears into the darkness, but the vehement words remain. Rahu tried to restrain those bad thoughts and focus on the current mission. While she waited for the contamination cleanup team to process the scene, she checked all the intel she could reach at hand.
The documents look like communication records, some encoded, others clear. Rahu mentally notes to be wary of traps as she dives into the details.

Many of the records focus on the tactics for the West District. Rahu isn't too invested in what's happening there, and she's not quite getting the bigger picture yet. She's only sure that the Underground has retreated to the West District to get a hold of BR-002, but the comeback of the Black Ring has thrown a wrench in their plans.

P: They're playing with the Rustfire again, stoking that Corpus, and are willing to give up their one "shackle" just to pull us back in. Feels just like 8 years ago; they're in a hurry.


H: That doesn't mean we're ahead. What's more intriguing than their endgame are the tricks up their sleeves.


H: Paradeisos's never been one for grand shows of manipulation. It doesn't fit their M.O. Cutting to the chase...

H: They're using Sinners, harnessing the strength of Mania in ways we didn't see coming.


P: You mean that knockoff?


S: Way before him. By N.F. 103 at the latest, they already rolled out this tech in the field. The "blossoms" I've raised are proof of that.


S: Back in N.F. 103, Paradeisos broke through the Primary Black Ring, sending orders to scores of folks in the DisSea. Their Hypercubes can't pull that off; it's got to be the deep Mania.
steps.female_content:
H: They're using Sinners, harnessing the strength of Mania in ways we didn't see coming.


P: You mean that knockoff?


S: Way before her. By N.F. 103 at the latest, they already rolled out this tech in the field. The "blossoms" I've raised are proof of that.


S: Back in N.F. 103, Paradeisos broke through the Primary Black Ring, sending orders to scores of folks in the DisSea. Their Hypercubes can't pull that off; it's got to be the deep Mania.

steps.content:
P: ****, huh... That should simplify things. Can your little **** find these folks? And take her out?


S: Hah. I get that we're short-staffed, but a little "help" on your end would be nice...

Rahu's breath quickens. The cryptic messages multiply, each with its unique meaning, and none boded well. She constantly tells herself that this might all be a setup, maybe even deceit. She has to keep her cool.
Right then, a new message pops up, clearing all her doubts.
S: Need backup, meet at this spot—

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...This is!
